How to move a deal forward
Prospecting: confirm there is a real problem and a budget owner.
Qualified: agree what success looks like and who else must say yes.
Proposal sent: put a date on the follow-up before you hang up.
Negotiation: trade, do not discount. Every concession buys something.
A deal quiet for more than two weeks is flagged Quiet. Call before you email.
Override the probability on a deal when you know better, and write why in the next step.
Every open deal has an expected close date
Probabilities match the stage guide or have a reason
Deals with no activity for a week are called or closed
Total weighted value written in the notes
Notes
Forecast number, biggest risk, biggest upside.
A deal with no activity for more than a week is quiet. Do one of these, in this order.
Send a short note asking for the one thing blocking progress.
Call the second contact at the account.
Offer a final date and move it to Closed lost if there is no reply.
